title: Hybrid Architecture
definition: A blend of personality and knowledge in an AI model, achieved through a combination of weights and RAG.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of a robot with a brain made up of two parts: one part stores facts and knowledge (RAG), and the other part controls how the robot behaves and talks (weights).
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A hybrid architecture in AI refers to a system that combines the personality and conversational abilities (weights) with the factual knowledge (RAG) in a unified model.
difficulty_levels.expert: The hybrid architecture is a novel approach to AI design that integrates the personality, conversational abilities, and factual knowledge of a model. This allows for more nuanced and contextually aware responses from the AI.

extra_fields.insight: The hybrid architecture offers a unique solution to the challenge of creating AI personas that are both knowledgeable and conversational.
